verdict.rationale: A public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question for a cloud scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, or postmortems. The Actor monitoring docs (apify-docs-7) cover users' own Actor performance alerts, which is an adjacent feature and not a public service-health page.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
